purpose.summary: This is a NIST CCVS85 conformance test program (SQ130A) that attempts to open a sequential mass-storage file for I-O when the file does not exist, expecting a permanent error with file status '35'. It validates that the COBOL runtime either terminates or continues correctly in the absence of a declarative error handler. Results are written to a print report file.
